name: acg-release
description: Apply ACG Box release standards only to repositories whose canonical GitHub owner is acg-box; the current macOS skill manages Developer ID-notarized Sparkle ZIP releases.

interface.longDescription: Apply ACG Box release standards only to repositories whose canonical GitHub owner is acg-box. The current macOS skill audits, migrates, normalizes, operates, and verifies Sparkle ZIP releases with Developer ID Application signing, Apple notarization and stapling, draft-first GitHub publication, and remote byte verification.
defaultPrompt: Audit this acg-box macOS Sparkle ZIP workflow against the Developer ID standard.
Migrate this acg-box macOS ZIP workflow to Developer ID signing and notarization.
Operate the next acg-box stable Sparkle ZIP release and verify its public bytes.
